MOD = 998244353

def count_partitions(n, parents):
    # Find all leaf nodes
    leaves = [i for i in range(2, n + 1) if parents[i - 2] == i]
    
    # If there are no leaves, there's only one way to partition (empty partition)
    if not leaves:
        return 1
    
    # Number of leaves
    k = len(leaves)
    
    # Calculate the number of ways to partition k leaves
    # This is equivalent to finding the number of ways to partition a set of k elements
    # which is 2^(k-1)
    return pow(2, k - 1, MOD)
